subscriptionIsolationRules.statement: A commercial entitlement, subscription expiry or failed payment never disables local steering or any PILOT safety behaviour.
A commercial entitlement never disables valid local sensing or changes a valid local measurement into an invalid one for commercial reasons.
A commercial entitlement never disables local alarms or other safety-relevant independent functions.

Payment failure or subscription expiry affects only the remote commercial entitlement and never disables local or safety-relevant functions. This is a design requirement of the specification, not a tested behaviour.
Remote cloud monitoring is only offered with an active WATCH monitoring subscription; no bundle may claim remote monitoring without that entitlement.
One account and one entitlement ledger; the same NAV or WEATHER entitlement is never billed twice across products or bundles (D-013).

senseKitExpansion.rule: A kit is packaging, not a new capability; it expands exactly to its declared module editions and never adds a module, measurement claim or connectivity of its own.

questions.question: Vessel type and intended use (coastal, offshore, inland, sail, motor)?
Hull material, length overall and displacement class?
Which instruments and data sources already exist and at what protocol/output?
Is there an existing autopilot or steering control system, and is it to remain untouched?
What local network, bus or serial interfaces are available (Signal K, NMEA 0183, other)?
DC power system voltage, protection and available circuits at the helm?
Engine and drive type, and whether any work touches the steering or motor circuit?
Cruising region and which licensed chart coverage the customer holds or intends to buy?
Connectivity available at berth, mooring and underway, and any existing SIM/data contract?
Customer-supplied phone, tablet or computer, operating system and version?
Preferred installation route (self-install, installer-assisted, professional) and DIY capability?
Who will own, administer and support the account after handover?
Any classification, insurance, warranty or regulatory constraint on the installation?
Exact steering system type, drive/actuator family and manufacturer documentation available?
Is independent rudder/steering feedback available and how is it measured?
Where can a physical emergency stop be mounted and how is it reachable from the helm?
How is independent motor-power isolation achieved and verified?
Is manual takeover possible at all times without tools or software?
Are documented commissioning and supervised sea-trial slots available with the installer?
Has a qualified installer or surveyor accepted the vessel-specific safety plan?
Does the owner accept that the system is supervised, local-only and not autonomous?
Are there classification, insurance or port-authority requirements that must be met first?
Organisation type and number of vessels to be managed?
Ownership structure: owned fleet, managed vessels, charter or mixed?
Required roles, permissions and approval workflows, and who administers them?
Which telemetry sources exist per vessel (WATCH, HUB, AIS, SENSE) and who owns them?
Connectivity and SIM/data contract situation per vessel?
Data protection role (controller/processor), retention, residency and deletion requirements?
Integration needs with existing maintenance, charter or accounting systems?
Contractual SLA requirement, and is measurement evidence available?
Procurement route, contract term and billing entity, VAT status and currency?
Training, onboarding and support expectations, and who attends them?

decisions.title: MC-08 bundle definitions are a distinct contract type
decisions.note: Six fixed bundles, 24 bundle fields, no new lifecycle and no order/sale outcome; a bundle never inherits product approval and a blocked product cannot be packaged into sale.

decisions.title: Canonical reference configurations and edition pairings fixed
decisions.note: START=HUB-STANDARD+NAV-PRO; CRUISE=NAV-ESSENTIAL+HUB-STANDARD+AIS-RECEIVER+DISPLAY-7; SAIL=NAV-PRO+HUB-STANDARD+PILOT-COASTAL+SENSE-WIND; PROTECT=WATCH-CORE+SENSE-ESSENTIALS; COMPLETE=NAV-PRO+HUB-PRO+DISPLAY-7+WATCH-CORE+SENSE-POWER/BILGE/TANKS/ENV+PILOT-COASTAL; FLEET package=FLEET subscription+onboarding/registration/training/support. AIS-CONNECTED conditional/not selected; DISPLAY-LARGE-CONDITIONAL never selectable.

decisions.title: PROTECT counts sensors once
decisions.note: The SENSE-ESSENTIALS kit expands exactly to SENSE-POWER+SENSE-BILGE; adding a loose module is a duplicate; HUB is not required for the WATCH data path and is optional.

decisions.title: SAIL and COMPLETE remain vessel-specific quotations
decisions.note: PILOT is never a priced bundle line, PILOT-PRO is never a retail SKU, fixedTurnkeyPriceApproved=false, pilotSurveyRequired=true, quoteRequired=true, release readiness BLOCKED (D-009).

decisions.title: MAREA FLEET package and MAREA FLEET SaaS remain distinct
decisions.note: contractedSolution=true, hardwareIncludedByDefault=false, onboardingPricingEstablished=false, no tenth family, no invented SLA.

decisions.title: Historical bundle price hypotheses remain unapproved
decisions.note: START/CRUISE are uninstalled first-year product-only references; PROTECT is HISTORIC_PRICE_NOT_COST_JUSTIFIED with final price OPEN; SAIL/COMPLETE are FULL_BUNDLE_PRICE_NOT_ESTABLISHED; FLEET package bespoke; no price approved.

decisions.title: Journey-stage reconciliation and bundle asset identity
decisions.note: README §22 17 stages remain canonical with MC-08 labels mapped; asset prefixes START-/CRUISE-/SAIL-/PROTECT-/COMPLETE-/FLEETPKG-; reconciliation 60 = 24 blocked + 30 reused + 6 authored; no real-product asset.

honestLimit: The bundle contract, its validator and its unit tests prove only that the machine-readable bundle definitions are internally consistent with the nine product contracts and the fixed composition rules. They are not evidence that an installed system works, that any device is compatible, that a vessel is safe to steer, that a measurement is accurate, that a supplier quote is deliverable, or that any bundle may be sold. Every bundle remains DEFINED, INTERNAL_ONLY and NOT_FOR_SALE; passing the validator is not a publication, sale or safety approval.

bundles.customerOutcome: Existing onboard data visible in modern MAREA NAV Pro navigation, locally and without replacing the existing instruments, with licensed charts and untested compatibility stated honestly.
bundles.idealCustomer: Owner of a coastal sail or motor vessel who keeps existing instruments and wants modern navigation plus onboard data without a full electronics refit.

configurationRules.name: Edition resolution
configurationRules.condition: An edition id is unknown, does not belong to the declared family, or contradicts the fixed reference edition
configurationRules.evidenceRequirement: The nine product contracts build the only registry; no parallel product-name list is permitted
configurationRules.notes: Structural: edition ids must exist in product-definitions.batch-01/02/03.json under the declared family id.

configurationRules.name: Dependency resolution
configurationRules.condition: A declared dependency is unresolved: WATCH without a monitoring entitlement, a promised outcome without a chart/data entitlement, or a quotation before a survey
configurationRules.evidenceRequirement: Dependency rules DR-* in each bundle and the entitlement matrix
configurationRules.notes: The deterministic path is: missing entitlement -> NOT_ELIGIBLE; missing survey before a quoted line -> SPECIALIST_SURVEY_REQUIRED; otherwise QUOTATION_REQUIRED.

configurationRules.name: General eligibility questionnaire
configurationRules.condition: The 13-question general questionnaire is incomplete or answers leave compatibility, device, chart coverage or installation route unknown
configurationRules.evidenceRequirement: Completed GQ-01 to GQ-13 with a device/firmware record and an installer assessment where applicable
configurationRules.notes: Unknown compatibility is never treated as compatible; it routes to human assessment.

configurationRules.name: Safety-sensitive questionnaire
configurationRules.condition: SQ-01 to SQ-09 is incomplete, or a failed safety prerequisite exists (no physical E-stop, no independent motor isolation, no rudder feedback, no supervised sea trial plan)
configurationRules.evidenceRequirement: Completed safety questionnaire, documented vessel and steering survey, qualified installer acceptance
configurationRules.notes: A failed safety prerequisite is NOT_ELIGIBLE; a survey still to be performed is SPECIALIST_SURVEY_REQUIRED.

configurationRules.name: B2B FLEET questionnaire
configurationRules.condition: FQ-01 to FQ-10 is incomplete or the organisation lacks contract, roles, connectivity or data-protection definition
configurationRules.evidenceRequirement: Completed B2B questionnaire, written contract scope and data-protection role assessment
configurationRules.notes: No self-service or standard-price path exists; every FLEET package is quoted.

configurationRules.name: Unknown compatibility

configurationRules.notes: SUPPORTED/TESTED is only permitted when a device test record flag is true; no bundle currently has one.

configurationRules.name: Failed safety prerequisite

conflictRules.condition: Remote cloud monitoring is offered without an active WATCH subscription or connectivity contract
conflictRules.evidenceRequirement: Subscription isolation rules and WATCH subscription service evidence
conflictRules.message: Remote monitoring requires a WATCH subscription and connectivity; no subscription-free cloud monitoring exists.

conflictRules.name: Missing chart/data entitlement
conflictRules.condition: The promised navigation outcome is configured without a licensed chart/data entitlement line
conflictRules.evidenceRequirement: A REQUIRED_EXTERNAL licensed chart entitlement line and a signed distribution/per-region right
conflictRules.message: Charts are a licensed external entitlement, never a product feature; a missing entitlement blocks the promised outcome.

conflictRules.name: NAV/WEATHER duplicated entitlement charge
conflictRules.condition: NAV and WEATHER entitlements are both charged for the same granted right, or a bundle adds a second WEATHER charge
conflictRules.evidenceRequirement: D-013: one entitlement ledger, prorated upgrades only
conflictRules.message: One account, one entitlement ledger: the same NAV or WEATHER entitlement is never billed twice.

conflictRules.name: Unverified sensor accuracy
conflictRules.scope: PROTECT, COMPLETE and any SENSE line
conflictRules.condition: A measurement accuracy, resolution or calibration figure is presented as achieved while SENSE_MEASUREMENT_ACCURACY = NOT_MEASURED
conflictRules.evidenceRequirement: Calibration and field-accuracy evidence per module
conflictRules.message: Sensor accuracy is not measured; no accuracy figure may be presented as achieved.

conflictRules.name: Unverified compatibility called SUPPORTED
conflictRules.condition: A compatibility row is labelled SUPPORTED or TESTED without a true device test record flag
conflictRules.evidenceRequirement: A recorded device test (device, firmware, direction, adapter, record, reviewer)
conflictRules.message: Only a recorded device test can promote a row; unverified compatibility is never SUPPORTED.

conflictRules.name: FLEET package confused with FLEET SaaS
conflictRules.condition: The package is described as the FLEET SaaS product family, or SaaS hardware/onboarding is assumed included in the per-vessel fee
conflictRules.evidenceRequirement: D-022: distinct package and family; hardwareIncludedByDefault=false; onboardingPricingEstablished=false
conflictRules.message: The MAREA FLEET package is a distinct contracted solution, not the FLEET SaaS family.

conflictRules.name: Cross-tenant access grant
conflictRules.condition: Any role or configuration permits access to another organisation tenant
conflictRules.evidenceRequirement: Server-side authorization, organisation-scoped tenancy and recorded isolation tests
conflictRules.message: Cross-tenant access is prohibited in every edition.

conflictRules.name: Remote PILOT command path
conflictRules.condition: Any line, subscription or integration introduces a remote, cloud-mediated or web steering/helm command
conflictRules.evidenceRequirement: Remote helm control is PROHIBITED; PILOT engagement is local only
conflictRules.message: No remote steering command path exists; PILOT engagement always stays local.

conflictRules.name: Approved price without verified costs
conflictRules.condition: A bundle price is approved, final or checkout-ready while BOM, supplier quotations, labour and channel costs are not established
conflictRules.evidenceRequirement: D-018/D-023: totalPriceEstablished=false and HYPOTHESIS_UNAPPROVED prices only
conflictRules.message: No price may be approved without verified costs; historical hypotheses remain unapproved.

conflictRules.name: Blocked product promoted to commercial availability through a bundle
conflictRules.condition: A bundle claims availability, approval, certification or a tested compatibility inherited from a blocked product
conflictRules.evidenceRequirement: Product availability NOT_FOR_SALE, brand and IP clearance NOT granted, safety gates unchanged
conflictRules.message: A bundle never inherits product approval: a blocked product cannot be packaged into sale.

crossSellRules.name: START to CRUISE
crossSellRules.condition: Customer needs a fixed helm display and receive-only AIS traffic
crossSellRules.message: Adds display and receive-only AIS; existing HUB/NAV scope is retained and never rebilled.

crossSellRules.name: CRUISE to COMPLETE
crossSellRules.condition: Customer wants one coordinated professional integration
crossSellRules.message: Adds integration, monitoring and supervised steering; quoted, never a fixed-price upgrade.

crossSellRules.name: START/CRUISE to SAIL
crossSellRules.condition: Customer wants supervised steering and measured wind
crossSellRules.message: Requires a vessel and steering survey and a quotation; existing hardware is retained where functional.

crossSellRules.name: PROTECT to COMPLETE
crossSellRules.condition: Customer wants navigation, display and integration in addition to monitoring
crossSellRules.message: Monitoring scope is retained; additional products are separately priced and never double-billed.

crossSellRules.name: FLEET package and FLEET SaaS are distinct
crossSellRules.condition: A professional operator buys the FLEET package
crossSellRules.message: The package is opt-in; the per-vessel SaaS fee never includes hardware and the package is never silently attached to a hardware purchase.

crossSellRules.name: NAV/WEATHER cross-sell recognises an active entitlement
crossSellRules.condition: The customer already holds a NAV or WEATHER entitlement
adds: integrated access to the already granted right
crossSellRules.message: An already granted entitlement is recognised, never rebilled (D-013).

crossSellRules.name: WATCH and HUB as FLEET options
crossSellRules.condition: The operator wants per-vessel telemetry or a local data source
crossSellRules.message: Hardware and its subscriptions are separate purchases and are never folded into the per-vessel fee.

crossSellRules.name: No cross-sell of ineligible items
crossSellRules.condition: An ineligible item would be cross-sold as an available retail line (PILOT-PRO as a priced SKU; DISPLAY-LARGE-CONDITIONAL as an available size)
crossSellRules.message: Ineligible items are never cross-sold as retail products or available sizes.
